verses.sloka: पूर्णे चतुर्दशे वर्षे पञ्चम्यां लक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।भरद्वाजश्रमं प्राप्य ववन्दे नियतो मुनिम् ।। ६.१२७.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: pūrṇe caturdaśe varṣe pañcamyāṁ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ ।bharadvājaśramaṁ prāpya vavande niyato munim ।। 6.127.1 ।।

translations.english: After the fourteenth year of exile, on the fifth day of the bright half of lunar month Sri Rama and Lakshmana reached Bharadwaja's hermitage. They bent their heads down (as a mark of respect) and offered salutations.

verses.sloka: सो ऽपृच्छदभिवाद्यैनं भरद्वाजं तपोधनम् ।शृणोषि कच्चिद्भगवन् सुभिक्षानामयं पुरे ।कच्चिच्च युक्तो भरतो जीवन्त्यपि च मातरः ।। ६.१२७.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: so 'pṛcchadabhivādyainaṁ bharadvājaṁ tapodhanam ।śṛṇoṣi kaccidbhagavan subhikṣānāmayaṁ pure ।kaccicca yukto bharato jīvantyapi ca mātaraḥ ।। 6.127.2 ।।

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana having greeted sage Bharadwaja who had asceticism as his wealth, enquired, saying, "Have you heard that crops have been good, Bharata is active, and mothers are doing well in Ayodhya?"
translations.hindi: सब लोगों के सामने पहिले कभी न सुने हुए ऐसे रूखे चचनों झो सुन कर, सीता जा ने लज्जित हो सिर नीचा कर लिआ

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण भरद्वाजो महामुनिः ।प्रत्युवाच रघुश्रेष्ठं स्मितपूर्वं प्रहृष्टवत् ।। ६.१२७.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa bharadvājo mahāmuniḥ ।pratyuvāca raghuśreṣṭhaṁ smitapūrvaṁ prahṛṣṭavat ।। 6.127.3 ।।

translations.english: When Rama had spoken that way to the great sage, Bharadwaja was delighted and with a smiling look replied.

verses.sloka: पङ्कदिग्धस्तु भरतो जटिलस्त्वां प्रतीक्षते ।पादुके ते पुरस्कृत्य सर्वं च कुशलं गृहे ।। ६.१२७.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: paṅkadigdhastu bharato jaṭilastvāṁ pratīkṣate ।pāduke te puraskṛtya sarvaṁ ca kuśalaṁ gṛhe ।। 6.127.4 ।।

translations.english: "Bharata is without attention to his body, wearing matted locks, placing your wooden sandals in front expecting you in the house. All is well at Ayodhya."

verses.sloka: त्वां पुरा चीरवसनं प्रविशन्तं महावनम् ।स्त्रीतृतीयं च्युतं राज्याद्धर्मकामं च केवलम् ।पदातिं त्यक्तसर्वस्वं पितुर्वचनकारिणम् ।। ६.१२७.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: tvāṁ purā cīravasanaṁ praviśantaṁ mahāvanam ।strītṛtīyaṁ cyutaṁ rājyāddharmakāmaṁ ca kevalam ।padātiṁ tyaktasarvasvaṁ piturvacanakāriṇam ।। 6.127.5 ।।

translations.english: "Rama! You, who are victorious in winning enemies, have earlier on account of father's words, intent on following father's words, accepting Kaikeyi's words, went with Lakshmana and Sita, clad in bark clothes, giving up kingdom and all possessions, like heaven set out on foot and entered huge forest, living on roots and fruits of the forest. Seeing you, compassion arose in me."
translations.hindi: , हे वीर ! तुम ऐसी अनुचित, कर्णकडु और रूखी बातें उस तरह क्यों कहते हो, जिस तरह गंवार आदमी अपनी गवार सनी से कहा करते हैं

verses.sloka: सर्वभोगैः परित्यक्तं स्वर्गच्युतमिवामरम् ।दृष्ट्वा तु करुणा पूर्वं ममासीत् समितिञ्जय ।। ६.१२७.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvabhogaiḥ parityaktaṁ svargacyutamivāmaram ।dṛṣṭvā tu karuṇā pūrvaṁ mamāsīt samitiñjaya ।। 6.127.6 ।।

translations.english: "Rama! You, who are victorious in winning enemies, have earlier on account of father's words, intent on following father's words, accepting Kaikeyi's words, went with Lakshmana and Sita, clad in bark clothes, giving up kingdom and all possessions, like heaven set out on foot and entered huge forest, living on roots and fruits of the forest. Seeing you, compassion arose in me."
translations.hindi: हे महाबाहो ! तुमने मुके जैता समझ रका है, में वैसी नहीं हूँ । इस विषय .में तुम! मेरे ऊपर विश्वास रक्खो । में अपने. < वातिब्रत घर्म की शपथ खा कर यह्‌ बात तुमसे कहती हू

verses.sloka: कैकेयीवचने युक्तं वन्यमूलफलाशिनम् ।। ६.१२७.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: kaikeyīvacane yuktaṁ vanyamūlaphalāśinam ।। 6.127.7 ।।

translations.english: "Rama! You, who are victorious in winning enemies, have earlier on account of father's words, intent on following father's words, accepting Kaikeyi's words, went with Lakshmana and Sita, clad in bark clothes, giving up kingdom and all possessions, like heaven set out on foot and entered huge forest, living on roots and fruits of the forest. Seeing you, compassion arose in me."

verses.sloka: साम्प्रतं सुसमृद्धार्थं समित्रगणबान्धवम् ।समीक्ष्य विजितारिं त्वां मम प्रीतिरनुत्तमा ।। ६.१२७.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sāmprataṁ susamṛddhārthaṁ samitragaṇabāndhavam ।samīkṣya vijitāriṁ tvāṁ mama prītiranuttamā ।। 6.127.8 ।।

translations.english: "I am happy to see you coming to me, who have completed the task and won the enemies and after successful completion, you are meeting relatives and friends."

verses.sloka: सर्वं च सुखदुःखं ते विदितं मम राघव ।। ६.१२७.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvaṁ ca sukhaduḥkhaṁ te viditaṁ mama rāghava ।। 6.127.9 ।।

translations.english: "Raghava, while you were sojourning at Janasthana, you experienced joy and sorrow abundantly all that is known to me."

verses.sloka: यत्त्वया विपुलं प्राप्तं जनस्थानवधादिकम् ।ब्राह्मणार्थे नियुक्तस्य रक्षितुः सर्वतापसान् ।। ६.१२७.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: yattvayā vipulaṁ prāptaṁ janasthānavadhādikam ।brāhmaṇārthe niyuktasya rakṣituḥ sarvatāpasān ।। 6.127.10 ।।

translations.english: "This irreproachable wife of yours was abducted by Ravana while you were engaged with the protection of all ascetics and entrusted with the care of brahmanas."

verses.sloka: रावणेन हृता भार्या बभूवेयमनिन्दिता ।मारीचदर्शनं चैव सीतोन्मथनमेव च ।। ६.१२७.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇena hṛtā bhāryā babhūveyamaninditā ।mārīcadarśanaṁ caiva sītonmathanameva ca ।। 6.127.11 ।।

translations.english: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."
translations.hindi: जब तुमने मुझे देखने के लिए हनुमान जी को लङ्का में भेजा था, तब उम्हींके द्वारा मेरे परित्याग की बात न्त कहला भेजी ?

verses.sloka: कबन्धदर्शनं चैव पम्पाभिगमनं तथा ।सुग्रीवेण च ते सख्यं यच्च वाली हतस्त्वया ।। ६.१२७.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: kabandhadarśanaṁ caiva pampābhigamanaṁ tathā ।sugrīveṇa ca te sakhyaṁ yacca vālī hatastvayā ।। 6.127.12 ।।

translations.english: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."
translations.hindi: यदि उस समय यह बात मुझे मालूम हो जाती, तो तुम्हारे भेजे हुए हनुमान्‌ के सामने ही तुम्हारो त्यागी हुई में, अपने प्राण त्याग देती

verses.sloka: मार्गणं चैव वैदेह्याः कर्म वातात्मजस्य च ।विदितायां च वैदेह्यां नलसेतुर्यथा कृतः ।। ६.१२७.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: mārgaṇaṁ caiva vaidehyāḥ karma vātātmajasya ca ।viditāyāṁ ca vaidehyāṁ nalaseturyathā kṛtaḥ ।। 6.127.13 ।।

translations.english: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."

verses.sloka: यथा वा दीपिता लङ्का प्रहृष्टैर्हरियूथपैः ।सपुत्रबान्धवामात्यः सबलः सहवाहनः ।। ६.१२७.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: yathā vā dīpitā laṅkā prahṛṣṭairhariyūthapaiḥ ।saputrabāndhavāmātyaḥ sabalaḥ sahavāhanaḥ ।। 6.127.14 ।।

translations.english: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."
translations.hindi: हे नरशादूल ! तुमने तो ओछे मनुष्यां को तरह क्रोध के वशवर्ती हो साधारण ख्यां की तरह मुझको भी समक. लिआ

verses.sloka: यथा विनिहतः सङ्ख्ये रावणो देवकम्टकः ।समागमश्च त्रिदशैर्यथा दत्तश्च ते वरः ।सर्वं ममैतद्विदितं तपसा धर्मवत्सल ।। ६.१२७.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: yathā vinihataḥ saṅkhye rāvaṇo devakamṭakaḥ ।samāgamaśca tridaśairyathā dattaśca te varaḥ ।sarvaṁ mamaitadviditaṁ tapasā dharmavatsala ।। 6.127.15 ।।

translations.english: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."

verses.sloka: अहमप्यत्र ते दद्मि वरं शस्त्रभृतां वर ।अर्ध्यमद्य गृहाणेदमयोध्यां श्वो गमिष्यसि ।। ६.१२७.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: ahamapyatra te dadmi varaṁ śastrabhṛtāṁ vara ।ardhyamadya gṛhāṇedamayodhyāṁ śvo gamiṣyasi ।। 6.127.16 ।।

translations.english: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."
translations.hindi: बाल्यावस्था में (विवाह के समय) तुमने जो मेरा हाथ पकड़ा था उसका भी तुमने प्रमाण न माना ! अपने प्रति मेरी भक्ति और मेरे शील की ओर से भी तुमने मुंड फेर लिआ

verses.sloka: तस्य तच्छिरसा वाक्यं प्रतिगृह्य नृपात्मजः ।बाढमित्येव संहृष्टो धीमान् वरमयाचत ।अकाले फलिनो वृक्षाः सर्वे चापि मधुस्रवाः ।। ६.१२७.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasya tacchirasā vākyaṁ pratigṛhya nṛpātmajaḥ ।bāḍhamityeva saṁhṛṣṭo dhīmān varamayācata ।akāle phalino vṛkṣāḥ sarve cāpi madhusravāḥ ।। 6.127.17 ।।

translations.english: "Jewel among the wielders of weapons! Now you take this water, and I shall bestow a boon to you. After taking my blessings you proceed to Ayodhya."
translations.hindi: टिएपणी-- तेजस्विनी सीता माता ने कैसी निर्भीकता से और खरे शब्दों में अपने प्रति की अनुचित भर्त्सना का समाधान किया है | सोता जी के इस कथन में ऐसी एक भी लाचर बात नहीं जिसका कोई खण्डन कर सका हो | एवं ब्रुवाणा रुदती बाष्पगद्ददरभाषिणी । अब्रवीकृक्ष्मणं सीता दीनं ध्यानपरं स्थितम्‌

verses.sloka: फलान्यमृतकल्पानि बहूनि विविधानि च ।भवन्तु मार्गे भगवन्नयोध्यां प्रति गच्छतः ।। ६.१२७.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: phalānyamṛtakalpāni bahūni vividhāni ca ।bhavantu mārge bhagavannayodhyāṁ prati gacchataḥ ।। 6.127.18 ।।

translations.english: Glorious son of emperor obeying the words of Bharadwaja bending his head in reverence requested for that boon.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! इस मिथ्यापवाद से पीडित हो, में अब जीना नहीं चाहती । अतः तुम अब मेरे लिए चिता बना दो। क्योंकि ऐसे रोग की एकमात्र यही औषध हे

verses.sloka: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाते वचनात् समनन्तरम् ।अभवन् पादपास्तत्र स्वर्गपादपसन्निभाः ।। ६.१२७.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tatheti ca pratijñāte vacanāt samanantaram ।abhavan pādapāstatra svargapādapasannibhāḥ ।। 6.127.19 ।।

translations.english: "O divine sage! Let all the trees bear fruits out of season of several kinds of many sweet and juicy, tasting nectar appear on our way as we proceed to Ayodhya."

verses.sloka: निष्फलाः फलिनश्चासन् विपुष्पाः पुष्पशालिनः ।शुष्काः समग्रपत्रास्ते नगाश्चैव मधुस्रवाः ।। ६.१२७.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: niṣphalāḥ phalinaścāsan vipuṣpāḥ puṣpaśālinaḥ ।śuṣkāḥ samagrapatrāste nagāścaiva madhusravāḥ ।। 6.127.20 ।।

translations.english: When Bharadwaja promised saying, 'Be it so' and the trees on all sides grew like heavenly trees.

verses.sloka: सर्वतो योजनास्तिस्रो गच्छतामभवंस्तदा ।। ६.१२७.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarvato yojanāstisro gacchatāmabhavaṁstadā ।। 6.127.21 ।।

translations.english: "Then while we were proceeding for three yojanas on all sides the trees that did not have fruits started bearing fruits, trees that did not have blossoms started having blossoms and the trees that dried up developed leaves and began to shed honey."
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की मुखार्कात से लक्ष्मण ने जान लिआ कि, वे भी यही चाहते हैं । अतः बीर्यवान्‌ श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के मतानुसार उन्होने चिता बनाकर तैयार कर दी

verses.sloka: ततः प्रहृष्टाः प्लवगर्षभास्ते बहूनि दिव्यानि फलानि चैव ।कामादुपाश्नन्ति सहस्रशस्ते मुदा ऽन्विताः स्वर्गजितो यथैव ।। ६.१२७.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ plavagarṣabhāste bahūni divyāni phalāni caiva ।kāmādupāśnanti sahasraśaste mudā 'nvitāḥ svargajito yathaiva ।। 6.127.22 ।।

translations.english: "Then while we were proceeding for three yojanas on all sides the trees that did not have fruits started bearing fruits, trees that did not have blossoms started having blossoms and the trees that dried up developed leaves and began to shed honey."
translations.hindi: ¦ नीचे की ओर मुख किए धीरे धीरे श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की परि- क्र मा कर, वैदेही दहकती हुई आग के निकट गई

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्तविंशत्युत्तरशततमः सर्गः ।। १२७ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe saptaviṁśatyuttaraśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 127 ।।

translations.english: Then those bulls among monkeys, greatly delighted, joyous as conquerors of heaven, ate their fill, at their pleasure, of divine fruits by the thousand.
translations.hindi: मैथिली ने देवताओं ओर ब्राह्मणों को प्रणामकर' अग्नि के पास खड़े होकर तथा हाथ जोड़ कर यह कहा
